lines: This chapter just broke the internet.
Kai finally unlocked the power he's been hiding for three years...
and plot twist? It isn't even his.
This is the Eren Yeager special all over again.
Everything you thought you knew? Wrong.
And the girl who could have stopped him saw it coming, and still walked straight into the trap.
Meanwhile the villain is sitting there like Light Yagami. Just as planned.
So yeah, the whole story just flipped,
and honestly? Nobody is ready for chapter forty.
